name: Stargate Milam County (SB Energy campus)
summary: A fast-build Stargate AI campus in Milam County, Texas, about 70 miles northeast of Austin, developed by SoftBank in partnership with OpenAI, with SoftBank's SB Energy providing the powered infrastructure. It was announced in September 2025 as one of two SoftBank sites that together could scale to 1.5 GW within about 18 months, and SoftBank said then that it was breaking ground. Analyst Epoch AI projects about 1.2 GW for this site, saw steel framing and roofing on the first building in March 2026 imagery, and cites state filings pointing to delivery of that building by October 2026. SB Energy plans to fund and build new generation and storage for most of the campus power.
